Your culinary adventure in the heart of the Alps

** Welcome to **Grill Imbiss Leckerland**, where the aroma of sizzling sausages and fresh mountain air blend seamlessly. Nestled in the breathtaking landscapes of **Tirol**, we invite you to indulge in hearty, traditional **Tiroler** flavors—smoked to perfection, served with a smile. --- **

Why we’re your go-to spot

** 🔥 **Authentic Grill Mastery** – From juicy **Wiener Würstchen** to smoky **Käsekrainer**, every bite is a taste of **Tirol’s** culinary soul. 🌿 **Fresh & Local** – Our ingredients are sourced straight from nearby farms, ensuring only the finest quality. 🏔️ **Alpine Vibes** – Whether you’re stopping by after a hike in the **Zillertal** or a day skiing in **Ischgl**, our rustic charm keeps the mountain spirit alive. 🍽️ **Quick & Hearty** – Perfect for a post-adventure refuel or a lazy afternoon by the **Inn River**. --- **

Must-try specialties

** 🍖 **Tiroler Grillplatte** – A mountain of flavors: **Käsekrainer**, **Leberkäse**, **Bratwurst**, and crispy **Speck**—all piled high with fresh onions and mustard. 🧀 **Käsespätzle mit Grillnote** – Creamy **Spätzle** loaded with melted **Tiroler Bergkäse**, topped with a smoky **Grillschinken** twist. 🍟 **Ofenknödel mit Sauerkraut** – Soft, pillowy **Knödel** stuffed with savory filling, served with tangy **Sauerkraut** and a side of **Grillmarinade**. 🍦 **Dessert: Kaiserschmarrn** – Fluffy, caramelized **Kaiserschmarrn** with powdered sugar and fresh berries—because even grilling deserves a sweet finish. --- **
